sql: SELECT e.series, count(*) AS barred, count(p.id) AS matched, coalesce(max(p.status),'-') AS st, round(sum(coalesce(p.pnl,0))::numeric,2) AS twin_pnl_usd FROM live_paper_parity_events e LEFT JOIN paper_positions p ON p.market_ticker=e.market_ticker AND p.strategy=e.twin_tag WHERE e.twin_tag='Fmmsell10_pt4' AND e.twin_outcome='opened' AND e.parent_outcome='skip_live_tier' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY twin_pnl_usd DESC
